```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml, html

data = yaml.safe_load(open("links.yml", encoding="utf-8"))

def section(name, items):
    out = [f'<h2 class="sec">{name}</h2>']
    for it in items:
        out.append(
            f'<a class="link" href="{html.escape(it["url"])}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'
            f'<span class="ico">{it["icon"]}</span>'
            f'<span class="txt">{html.escape(it["title"])}</span></a>'
        )
    return "\n".join(out)

page = f'''
<main class="card">
  <img class="avatar" src="avatar.jpg" alt="Diego Carvalho">
  <h1>Diego Carvalho, D.Sc.</h1>
  <p class="bio">Professor and researcher<br><i>Universidade Federal de Ciência e Inovação do Rio de Janeiro<br>Federal University of Science and Innovation of Rio de Janeiro</i></p>
  {section("Professional", data["professional"])}
  {section("Contact &amp; Social", data["social"])}
  <footer>2026 © Diego Carvalho</footer>
</main>
'''
print(page)
```
